title: My registration: {title}
error: Your registration could not be read

invalid.title: This link is no longer valid
invalid.description: It may have been replaced by a more recent email: open the latest one. Without an email, register again from the day's page.

cancelled.title: You are unregistered
cancelled.description: Your registration for this day is cancelled: you will receive neither reminders nor the live link.

following: You follow no activity out of {total}: the live stream stays open all day. | You follow {count} activity out of {total}; a reminder reaches you before it. | You follow {count} activities out of {total}; a reminder reaches you before each one.

live.lead: The day has started. The link is the same from opening to closing.
live.before: On the day, a "Join the day's live stream" button will appear here; the link in the email leads to the same stream.

none: No activity kept: the live stream stays open all day, without reminders.

cancel.title: Unregister from the day?
cancel.description: You will no longer receive reminders, and the live link will no longer open the day for you.
